ledger_accounts_owner.name: ledger_accounts_owner
ledger_accounts_owner.value: ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'user' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'house' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL)

bets_settled_amounts.name: bets_settled_amounts
bets_settled_amounts.value: ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'void') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('pending_acceptance', 'open', 'rejected') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NULL))
